verdicts.reason: A shrinks the '48H ONLY' badge to an unreadable pink dot jammed against the bottom of the lime panel, so the urgency message is lost, and the panel runs almost edge to edge with thin, uneven margins. B keeps the badge readable as a badge, but it is too small (the text is tiny) and stranded in the top-left corner; the full-bleed panel also leaves the orphans 'price' and 'stock.', though its hierarchy and box scale are sound.

A squashes the round '48H ONLY' badge into a distorted ellipse and wedges it between the subhead and the CTA, which breaks the brand shape and clutters the panel; the subhead also crowds the headline, and the box is undersized, leaving a lot of dead stripe area. B (the same as pair 1 B) has a tiny, hard-to-read badge stuck in the corner and orphaned words in the headline and subhead, but its proportions and hierarchy stay intact.
